490202.caption: Commander, your orders? I'm ready to deploy anytime.

490203.caption: My strength is yours to command, Commander.

490204.caption: If you want to understand me better, then please allow me to demonstrate my prowess in battle.

490205.caption: Don't worry, Commander, I'll keep myself safe during this operation. After all, I promised you long ago that I won't ever have you worry about me anymore.
